description: C1: the first standing stone of the colossi, on its rise in the Hoarfell beyond the rim: grows a giant to stages 7, 8 and 9 (max_stage 9; D3: the stone of every colossus, decision D3-3). Its growth conditions are the stages' own (each profile's growth_requirement, decisions C1-3 and D3-2): stage 7 once act two has begun and the stone is reached; stage 8 once the Frostbound Titan has fallen; stage 9 once the Stormcaller has fallen. A checkpoint, a rest and the loadout.
